rationale.classification: mixed: accidental HMR closure fixed; later accepted capability growth rolled prospectively
rationale.accidentalClosureFix: The 8ce5ca33e HMR handoff statically pulled the result-contract compiler, RQS hashing, and complete re-admission loop into every React entry. react-binding-hmr.mjs now remains behind a literal development-only dynamic import, so none of those bytes are included in this successor ceiling.
rationale.legitimateGrowth: The remaining React mass is the accepted LLP 0179 provider.surface/useSurface composition and LLP 0180 synchronous CommandTask projection, including its asset client. Moving that implementation behind an asynchronous boundary would change provider.surface(...) and start(...) returning a ready binding/task synchronously; a narrow compatibility-preserving React entry requires a separate composition design and is tracked in issues/20260806-react-optional-capability-composition.md.
rationale.smallDriftDisposition: The operation-lifecycle, tombstone/re-entry, assets, and retained-store correctness changes are the measured small-drift cluster. They are real shipped client behavior, so exactly their affected profiles advance while all unrelated ceilings and historical receipts remain immutable.
rationale.summary: This disposition removes the accidental 35% HMR closure step, then records only the remaining accepted August client capability and correctness mass across the ten profiles that still exceed their active ceilings.
